title: Tom Holland speaks about the new Spider-Man movie – level 2
paragraphs: A new Marvel movie called Spider-Man: Brand New Day is coming to theaters on July 31. In this story, Peter Parker lives alone because a magic spell made everyone forget who he is. His best friends no longer remember him.

Actor Tom Holland says the film is emotional and shows why people need help from others. During his journey, Spider-Man meets new allies, including The Punisher, Yelena Belova, and Bruce Banner. Actress Sadie Sink also plays a mystery character, but her role is still a secret.
Director Destin Daniel Cretton hopes that fans will stop guessing all the surprises before going to the cinema so they can enjoy the film more.

words.d: magic words or actions used to make something special happen
a person or group which helps and supports another person in a difficult situation or fight
to answer without being sure about it
